source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of sex-limited and sex-influenced traits, block for block, with the Kitab ki ghalti box (PDF 110-111).

blocks.text: Kuch khasiyatein sex-linked nahi hotin (kyunke un ke alleles sex chromosomes par nahi), phir bhi un ki ratio nar aur maada mein mukhtalif hoti hai. Aisi khasiyaton ki do qismein hain.
